title: Cardinal Billing Account Additional-Premium Bill: Amount and Due Date
content:
**Computation clause.** On a Cardinal Billing Account, an additional premium received after the last installment of its term was invoiced is billed at once as an additional-premium bill, due the pay plan's immediate-bill due days (calendar days) after the bill date. The additional-premium bill is the additional premium received most recently on the account plus the pay plan's installment fee as its billing charge, rounded to the cent. The billing charge is never less than zero, and only the sum of the additional premium and the billing charge is rounded to the cent.

## Inputs

| Input | Where it is read |
|---|---|
| Additional premium | The additional-premium entry received most recently on the account's billing history |
| Billing charge | The pay plan's installment fee |
| Due date | The bill date plus the pay plan's immediate-bill due days, in calendar days |

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

- An additional premium of $64.00 on a plan whose installment fee is $5.00: the additional-premium bill is $64.00 plus $5.00, that is $69.00.
- An additional premium of $112.37 on a plan whose installment fee is $8.00: $120.37.
- A bill dated day B on a plan whose immediate-bill due days are 20 falls due on day B plus 20.

## Points of judgement

- **Which premium?** The additional premium received most recently on the account.
- **When is it rounded?** Once, on the sum of the additional premium and the billing charge.
- **What date does the due period run from?** The bill date, counted in calendar days.
